_comment: Local reference copy — updated 2026-06-07. Live ID: Bj5b3sUexa8EeQcK. Phase 4 workflow. Inbound-SMS keyword router for reschedule/cancel requests. Tested live via simulated inbound-SMS pin data (executions 63/64/65): (1) reschedule intent from a phone matching a live Scheduled appointment correctly found the row, replied to the customer, alerted the owner, and appended a Notes entry while preserving Status='Scheduled'; (2) cancel intent on the same row correctly set Status='Cancelled', sent a cancellation+rebooking-invite reply, and alerted the owner to follow up; (3) an unmatched phone number correctly fell through to the 'no appointment found' reply with zero false matches. Irrelevant inbound texts (intent='other') are silently ignored at the 'Is Reschedule or Cancel?' gate — no reply sent, no noise. COMPLIANCE FIX (2026-06-07, executions 67/68): 'Normalize Inbound SMS' was patched to detect standalone SMS opt-out keywords (STOP, UNSUBSCRIBE, QUIT, etc.) as a defense-in-depth backstop — these now route to intent='other' (silently ignored, zero auto-reply) instead of being misclassified as appointment-cancellation requests, removing a real TCPA/carrier-compliance exposure. Verified live: a bare 'STOP' → intent='other' → no reply sent; 'please cancel my roofing appointment, something came up' → intent='cancel' → full cancellation flow runs correctly (the word 'cancel' inside a longer sentence is still recognized as an appointment request, not an opt-out).
